Seems to me like ads are the #1 source of revenue on the internet. I try to disable it on sites that don't go absolutely overboard with ads (usually just video streaming and download sites). I could see a movement towards ads that are harder to block because they require no client side code or plugins whatsoever outside of HTML/CSS. In other words a hardcoded HTML/image/link ad is automatically pulled and generated via PHP. These style of ads will probably be less annoying for users since they're less likely to have animation, video, or audio so I'd say that's a win-win. I suppose ads that don't require client side scripts or plugins can still be blocked by analyzing patterns or blocking external domains/ips that tend to be used for ads but that could get more difficult.

Better ads, which will bypass adblockers, and the cycle will repeat.
